full_judgment: 20. This court is also not oblivious of the fact that instant case originated as back as in the year 1996 and this court could also consider the evidence on record, had it been a case of reversal, but in the instant case, since it is found that both the courts below did not at all consider or assess the evidence on record, this court does not feel it proper to embark upon a task which is specifically assigned to the trial Court and not to a revisional court like the present one.
